no_pooled_claim: This cell reads ONE quantity: the per-row intent verdict on a gold-selected subset. It may never be reported as a pooled SLU-F1 or intent-accuracy effect, as an admission, as a replication, or as evidence about any roster. Its population is the mechanism's own beneficiaries; a pooled number computed over it would be a selection artefact by construction. The cell also cannot see harm: every row here is already intent-wrong in the comparator, so the rows where the key could COST a correct intent -- including the rows that LOSE their gold entry under the centroid key, counted in the roster derivation -- are outside this roster and remain a construction cell's own question.
prohibitions: No pooled, roster-level, effectiveness, superiority or generalisation claim from this cell, ever -- its population was selected with gold.
No admission entry and no admission mode: the cell claims nothing and asks for nothing.

No second factor: no k, tau, fuse_coverage, rank-weight, store, release or snapshot change; no store rebuild or release; no re-pin of the 211 committed configs.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-KPROBE-FOLD-A-55-V1.note: The cell measures a CONDITIONAL RATE and makes NO effectiveness claim. Its 55 rows are under the measurement instrument's MIN_BENEFIT_ROWS, so under rule 5 this is a form proof by size and claims_benefit is false; expected_effect_pp is 0.0 because the cell registers no effect to look for. What it delivers is the centroid boundary key's conversion from delivery to correctness, measured: of the rows whose gold intent's boundary entry the key newly delivers, the proportion m/55 that move from a wrong intent to the gold intent. RE-DECLARATION RULE: a later 1,080-row construction cell that flies this key declares expected_effect_pp = m x 0.092615 pp intent accuracy (intent primary under owner decision 133, official SLU-F1 the non-inferiority guard; m x 0.041615 pp SLU-F1 for the guard), never a midpoint. It is NOT an admission request: no admission mode is declared, no harm margin is claimed, and no pooled or roster-level number may ever be read off this cell, whose population was selected with gold, offline.
SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-KPROBE-FOLD-A-55-V1.primary_metric: per-row intent correctness (official scorer's scenario_action_exact), reported as the conditional rate P(correct | newly delivered) with a binomial CI95

construction.construction_pool: the R01-excluded pool, so one file is held out on TRAIN Fold A, ROLL-1 (R01C) and DEV-2000-ADDED alike

construction.rule: for each released intent, take every construction-pool facet whose frozen build-time task_target names that intent, in pool facet-id order; unit-normalise each member vector in float64 (rails.kb_policy._cosine_with_norms' own quotient); take the arithmetic mean over the members; unit-normalise the mean. An intent with no member in this pool keeps the flown written key vector, byte for byte.

treatment_key_file.not_re_pinned: only this cell's derived baseline pins the centroid file; the 211 committed configs that pin the written key are untouched (owner decision 145), and the store rebuild waits on this cell's m
treatment_key_file.why_a_new_receipt_kind: The text-facet kind pins a text_sha256 per facet because each written key WAS a text run through the encoder. A centroid has no text source and no encoder pass: it is arithmetic over already-pinned utterance vectors. This kind therefore pins, per facet, the construction, the member count, the sha256 of the sorted member facet-id list and the sha256 of the emitted vector, plus every input pin and the loader implementation hashes, so the file is reproducible from the pins alone.

why_intent_and_not_slu_f1: The within-flight null (docs/results/2026-09-24-slurp-stage3-roll-aa-within-flight-null-read.md) measured 0 intent flips out of 200 request-identical rows, so an intent flip is ATTRIBUTABLE rather than noise and a per-row intent read is legible at this size; cell CONV read the same quantity the same way at n = 70 (docs/results/2026-09-27-slurp-conv-probe-read.md). Pooled SLU-F1 is not legible here: its own measured noise would swamp the roster, and the official SLU-F1 is entity-only while this mechanism acts on the intent. The official scorer still produces the number -- the read takes its per-sample scenario_action_exact field and nothing else -- so the standard-scoring rule is intact.
